items.title: milonite 提出“同交易内创建再销毁”的退还问题
items.note: 2026-11-16 19:56：EIP-8037 对同一交易内创建并自毁的合约仍收取 183,600 的账户创建 state gas，CREATE 从 32,000 涨到约 195,600（约 6 倍），用这种模式的整笔交易涨 1.6 到 2.8 倍。该模式用于临时充值地址等场景，主网约每天 2,100 个（2026-11-06），8 月约 1,200 个。原文的退还条款在 2026 年 5 月被 PR #11611 删除，恢复提案 PR #12249 被关闭；作者请求重新考虑，并指出 TCREATE（EIP-8360）不在 Glamsterdam 里，也不能直接替代已发出的地址。
items.note_en: At 19:56 on 2026-11-16: EIP-8037 still charges the full 183,600 state gas for account creation when a contract is created and self-destructed in the same transaction. CREATE goes from 32,000 to about 195,600 gas (roughly 6x), and whole transactions using the pattern cost 1.6x to 2.8x more. The pattern is used for temporary deposit addresses and similar flows, at about 2,100 contracts a day on mainnet (2026-11-06), up from about 1,200 in August. The original refund section was removed by PR #11611 in May 2026 and the proposal to restore it, PR #12249, was closed. The author asks for it to be reconsidered and notes TCREATE (EIP-8360) isn't in Glamsterdam and can't replace addresses already issued.

items.title: ethresear.ch：EIP-8288 的后量子签名聚合实测
items.note: 2026-11-16 23:33，MultiVM Labs 的 manel1874 在 leanVM 下证明 Falcon-512、ML-DSA-44、FORS、Raccoon-128、Raccoon-G 五种签名的验证（Apple M4 Pro、24 GiB）。前四种能放进一个 leanSTARK；Raccoon-G 约 8.39 亿见证字超过 2.68 亿的上限，只能拆成 5 个证明再递归聚合。单签名测量中只有 Falcon-512 和 FORS 的峰值内存低于 4 GiB，因此更适合浏览器钱包。作者提出钱包本地签名、交给不受信任的外部聚合器出证明的流程，并指出 8288 草案里 LEANSTARK_SCHEME 仍为保留值、MAX_LEANSTARK_DEPS_PER_WRAPPER=1 需要调整。作者也在 EIP-8288 讨论帖 23:42 引用了这组数据。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: benchmarking post-quantum signature aggregation for EIP-8288
items.note_en: At 23:33 on 2026-11-16. manel1874 of MultiVM Labs proved verification of five schemes under leanVM (Falcon-512, ML-DSA-44, FORS, Raccoon-128 and Raccoon-G) on an Apple M4 Pro with 24 GiB. The first four fit in a single leanSTARK; Raccoon-G needs about 839 million witness words against a 268 million cap, so it was split into five proofs and aggregated recursively. In single-signature runs only Falcon-512 and FORS peaked below 4 GiB of memory, which makes them the plausible browser candidates. The post sketches a flow where the wallet signs locally and an untrusted external aggregator produces the proof, and notes that LEANSTARK_SCHEME is still reserved in the 8288 draft and MAX_LEANSTARK_DEPS_PER_WRAPPER=1 would need revisiting. The author also cited these numbers in the EIP-8288 discussion thread at 23:42.

items.topic: Frame 交易账户：mempool 规则、权限分级和密钥恢复
items.title: EIP-8151 PR #12653 合并
items.note: 2026-11-16 17:09，新增公共 mempool 规则。EIP-8151 让 ecRecover 只对“无代码或 EIP-7702 委托”的账户返回结果，因此 EIP-8141 验证前缀里调用它会依赖第三方账户的代码。新规则：把每个被恢复的地址及其代码类别记为签名者依赖（tx.sender 除外），类别变化时重新验证；限制依赖同一恢复地址的待处理交易数，并按摘要分两档（针对本交易签名哈希 TXPARAM(0x08) 的恢复占保留份额，其他摘要占更小的份额，因为任何人都能拿到旧签名重放）；paymaster 的恢复每个 paymaster 只计一次。
items.note_en: At 17:09 on 2026-11-16, adding public mempool rules. EIP-8151 makes ecRecover return a result only for accounts with no code or an EIP-7702 delegation, so an EIP-8141 validation prefix that calls it depends on a third party's code. The new rules record each recovered address and its code class as a signer dependency (except tx.sender) and revalidate when the class changes. They cap pending transactions per recovered address in two shares: recoveries over this transaction's signature hash, TXPARAM(0x08), use a reserved share, while other digests get a smaller one, because anyone can replay an old signature. Paymaster recoveries count once per paymaster.

items.title: ERC-8499 讨论
items.note: 2026-11-16 20:26 至 20:28，作者 johba 回应两点：签名计数是状态，助记词恢复不了，所以签名上限可能被用到的密钥类型，从助记词派生的密钥只用于给其他密钥做认证，每台设备用自己的密钥签名；恢复后找不到在用密钥时，钱包要说明尝试过哪些密钥类型、其他钱包可能找得到。
items.note_en: 20:26 to 20:28 on 2026-11-16. Author johba addressed two points. A signature count is state and a phrase restores none, so for key types whose limit could realistically be reached, the phrase-derived key should only certify other keys and each device should sign with its own. And when a restore finds no key in use, the wallet should say which key types it tried and that another wallet might find keys it didn't.

items.note: Trezor 发货合作方 Skladon 数据泄露，The Block 2026-11-16 报道：约 2.7 万个 2026-08-09 至 11-07 的订单的姓名、电话、地址、邮箱和购买明细被导出，Trezor 系统和钱包备份未受影响，已有用户接到诈骗电话。买过的用户对任何“订单相关”的联系保持警惕，绝不提供助记词。
items.note_en: Data breach at Trezor shipping partner Skladon, reported by The Block on 2026-11-16: names, phone numbers, addresses, emails and purchase details for about 27,000 orders placed from 2026-08-09 to 11-07 were exported. Trezor's systems and wallet backups weren't affected, but some customers have already had scam calls. If you ordered in that window, treat any order-related contact as suspicious and never share your recovery phrase.

items.topic: 社区讨论
items.title: Barnabé Monnot 回应 Mike Neuder
items.note: 2026-11-16 13:50：Frames 给执行层带来密码学敏捷性，先给一种签名方案特权并不排斥其他方案；共识层敏捷性较低，主要问题是性能，比如是否必须支持 DVT（签名大小翻倍）。
items.title_en: Barnabé Monnot responding to Mike Neuder
items.note_en: At 13:50 on 2026-11-16: Frames give the execution layer cryptographic agility, and privileging one signature scheme early doesn't exclude others. The consensus layer has less agility built in, and the main question there is performance, for example whether DVT support is required, which doubles signature sizes.

summary_en: ACDT #103 heard the audit results on the Glamsterdam repricing. ChainSecurity and the EF's internal search found about 200 issues between them, most of them easy to mitigate, but the call didn't decide whether to pull EIP-8037 from Amsterdam and left that to ACDE on 11-19. Vitalik came out in support of EIP-8037 and listed protocol features he expects to change, including a stateful ecrecover and possibly EIP-8141 as the only transaction type. He also says he's now a "total bull" on the leanPCS route for EIP-8288, which is on the agenda for tonight's Frame Transaction Breakout #8 at 21:00.
